atomic_account_plus_first_device.transition_rule: each step is durable before its external effect or response; recovery resumes the same operation and reconciles an ambiguous effect before retry

provisioning_subject_id.canonical_encoding: ASCII lowercase; UUID hyphen form; JCS string in signed payload
provisioning_subject_id.issuance: canonical UUIDv7: timestamp component follows the selected UUIDv7 profile, remaining random fields are CSPRNG-generated, and PDSA durably reserves the identifier before response; never derived from caller, Windows identity, account, user, or hardware
provisioning_subject_id.operation_binding: PDSA package binds provisioning_subject_id and enrollment_reference only; after package verification LPPI separately binds its newly issued provisioning_operation_id to the exact package digest and those identities

pre_enrollment_request.relationship_to_existing_contracts: canonical envelope over the existing TPMEnrollmentRequestV1, TPMEnrollmentChallengeV1, TPMEnrollmentChallengeResponseV1 and their VerifiedTPMEnrollmentExchangeV1 result; it does not replace or rename those wire contracts

canonical_digest.derivation: SHA256(exact RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 canonical payload bytes)

authentication.tpm: ProductionTPMAttestationVerifier must accept the exact retained TPMEnrollmentRequestV1/challenge/response exchange; public projection ID, EK/AK digests and exchange reference must equal this payload
authentication.challenge: PDSA challenge is issuer-generated, signed, retained as ISSUED, exact-bound by ID/digest/nonce digest, and atomically consumed only with the accepted request digest

request_signature_profile.verification_key: exact pre_enrollment_public_key_canonical_bytes after canonical SEC1 validation and fingerprint recomputation
request_signature_profile.signed_bytes: UTF8("CryptoHunter.Stage9.PreEnrollmentRequest.v1") || 0x00 || pre_enrollment_request_digest_sha256 (32 raw bytes decoded from its 64-character lowercase hex encoding)
request_signature_profile.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s)

authentication.public_key_fingerprint_verification: pre_enrollment_public_key_fingerprint_sha256 MUST equal lowercase hex SHA256(exact decoded 65-byte pre_enrollment_public_key_canonical_bytes); recompute before signature verification

pre_enrollment_key.public_key_validation: exactly 65 bytes, first byte 0x04, X and Y each exactly 32-byte unsigned big-endian values, point is on NIST P-256 and is not point-at-infinity
pre_enrollment_key.fingerprint_derivation: lowercase hex SHA256(exact 65 canonical SEC1 uncompressed public-key bytes)
pre_enrollment_key.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s); reject non-minimal DER, trailing bytes, r/s outside valid P-256 order range, and high-S

custody_requirements.location: target TPM before PDSA package issuance
custody_requirements.verification: TPM-backed creation/custody evidence and request-key proof of possession exact-bound to target TPM projection

pre_enrollment_request.retained_acceptance: PDSA stores exact canonical request bytes and digest with challenge consumption before package publication

field_encodings.pre_enrollment_public_key_canonical_byte: exactly 130 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SEC1 0x04 || X32 || Y32

pdsa_enrollment_authorization_package.expiration_rule: expires_at_utc is REQUIRED canonical UTC; package is rejected at or after expiry and no implicit no-expiry is allowed

signature_profile.key_source: verified production release-policy PDSA key set only

request_and_device_binding.challenge_rule: package challenge ID/digest must equal the PDSA-retained challenge consumed by the exact accepted pre-enrollment request; unknown, unconsumed or differently bound challenge is rejected
request_and_device_binding.request_rule: pre_enrollment_request_digest_sha256 equals SHA256 of exact accepted canonical PreEnrollmentRequestV1 bytes
request_and_device_binding.tpm_rule: package exchange reference, public projection ID and EK/AK digests equal both the accepted verified TPM exchange and the enrolling host live verified public projection
request_and_device_binding.request_key_rule: package algorithm profile and fingerprint equal the accepted request key after verifier recomputes lowercase hex SHA256 of exact 65-byte SEC1 key; LPPI proves possession of its non-exportable target-TPM private key before package acceptance
request_and_device_binding.cloning_rule: any mismatch in request digest, challenge, TPM projection/EK/AK, exchange reference, request-key profile or fingerprint returns REJECT_PACKAGE_TARGET_MISMATCH

retained_issuance_record.commit: atomically persist challenge consumption, exact request digest and exact package bytes/digest before response

lppi_authority_key_lifecycle.pre_enrollment_key: generated before package, device-local and non-exportable; its fingerprint is signed by PDSA package
lppi_authority_key_lifecycle.authority_key: generated only on the verified target after package acceptance as a non-exportable TPM-backed Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider ECDSA P-256 key; private material is device-local and absent from package

continuity_signature_profile.signing_key: exact pre-enrollment key authenticated in PreEnrollmentRequestV1
continuity_signature_profile.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s)
continuity_signature_profile.public_key_encoding: SEC1 uncompressed P-256 point, exactly 65 bytes 0x04 || X32 || Y32
continuity_signature_profile.public_key_fingerprint_verification: continuity verifier decodes the exact request SEC1 key bytes, recomputes lowercase hex SHA256, and requires equality with request, package, binding and continuity signer fingerprint before signature verification

authority_key_pop_profile.signing_key: exact candidate LPPI authority key in binding payload
authority_key_pop_profile.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s)

lppi_authority_key_lifecycle.trust_gate: ProvisioningMembershipBinding and LPPIAuthenticatedProvisioningOperationBinding verify only with the exact ACTIVE key profile and fingerprint from active_key_record; key status alone, alias, key ID or caller key is insufficient

authority_key_profile.public_key_encoding: canonical TPMT_PUBLIC bytes for the TPM-backed CNG key
authority_key_profile.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s); reject non-minimal, trailing bytes, out-of-range or high-S signatures

custody.private_key_location: target TPM through Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider; service opens a persisted machine key by exact provider/key identity
custody.non_exportability_enforcement: TPM-backed persisted CNG key with export policy forbidding private export; verifier rejects software provider, exportable key, missing TPM attestation or mismatched public area/Name
verifier_rules: provider equals Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider

canonical TPMT_PUBLIC digest and recomputed TPM Name equal binding payload

provisioning_operation_id.issuance: LPPI generates canonical UUIDv7 only after successful exact production PDSA package verification, using the selected UUIDv7 timestamp profile plus CSPRNG random bits, then durably reserves it before publication or effect

mapping.rule: CHA durably assigns exactly one logical_operation_id to the authenticated provisioning operation before account reservation; the mapping is immutable

signature_profile.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s)

lppi_authenticated_operation_binding.immutability: append-only exact package/subject/enrollment/operation tuple; conflicting retry is rejected

provisioning_membership.durability: commit signed canonical bytes and current CAS before publication
provisioning_membership.lookup: exact claim reference plus current non-revoked designation
provisioning_membership.expiration: null unless signed policy specifies an instant; expiry fails closed
provisioning_membership.revocation: signed monotonic successor; deletion is forbidden
provisioning_membership.rollback_resistance: LPPI retained head plus separate protected freshness TPM NV anchor; disk state behind the anchor fails closed

pdsa_trust_domain.test_policy: existing TEST_ONLY fixtures may be used only by test composition

protected_freshness_authority.responsibility: current-designation monotonicity and disk rollback detection outside restorable StateStore

tpm_nv.role: owner-hierarchy NV counter and policy-bound head authorization for monotonic local anti-rollback only
tpm_nv.failure: mismatch, ambiguous increment, missing policy or disk-behind-counter fails closed
tpm_nv.tpm_loss_recovery: signed PDSA/recovery replacement binding retained predecessor and advancing lineage; never automatic unseen state

definition_hierarchy.purpose: defines and manages the NV index; it does not authorize increment through ownerAuth

TPMA_NV_COUNTER.reason: the index is a monotonic TPM NV counter incremented with TPM2_NV_Increment

TPMA_NV_POLICYWRITE.reason: TPM2_NV_Increment requires the frozen policy session authorization path

TPMA_NV_POLICYREAD.reason: the selected public-counter profile intentionally permits read through the fixed empty index authValue instead of a policy session

TPMA_NV_OWNERWRITE.reason: ownerAuth must not bypass policy-only increment authorization

TPMA_NV_OWNERREAD.reason: ownerAuth is not a read path; the selected non-secret counter read uses only the frozen empty index authValue

TPMA_NV_AUTHWRITE.reason: index authValue/password/HMAC must not bypass policy-only increment authorization

TPMA_NV_AUTHREAD.reason: counter value is non-secret and may be read with the fixed empty NV authValue; this does not authorize increment

TPMA_NV_PLATFORMCREATE.reason: the index is owner-hierarchy defined and platform hierarchy is forbidden

TPMA_NV_NO_DA.reason: the fixed empty read authValue must not consume dictionary-attack budget; write remains policy-only

write_authorization.required_path: TPMA_NV_POLICYWRITE with the exact frozen authPolicy

read_authorization.required_path: TPMA_NV_AUTHREAD with the frozen empty NV authValue using an ordinary password session

tpm_nv.operation_rule: durable signed pending head precedes increment; after lost response LPPI rereads through the frozen AUTHREAD path and reconciles without issuing a second increment
